title: Velvety Argentinian Beef Empanadas
description: Rich and comforting empanadas filled with tender beef and creamy single cream, fried to a golden brown and served on a vibrant talavera plate
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent
Stir in the single cream and bring the mixture to a simmer, cooking until the cream has thickened and the mixture is heated through
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass
Spoon a small amount of the beef and cream mixture onto the center of each dough circle
Brush the edges of the dough with the beaten egg and fold the dough in half, pressing the edges together to seal the empanada
Fry the empanadas in batches until they are golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side
Drain the empanadas on paper towels and serve hot on a talavera plate
